name: Jitte
source:
I'm a tool called a "jitte" that was used by dōshin  in the Edo period. I'm a jitte—specifically, a jitte matchlock gun.
They converted me from a regular jitte into a gun, so I guess I'm a kind of odd firearm. When it comes to apprehending criminals, leave it to me.
I'll deliver justice and strike down evil in fine style!
Master, I look forward to working with you from now on.
